properties.site-address: Fern House and Unit 24 Daniels Industrial Estate, Bath Road, Stroud
properties.notes: Main constraints: Regenerating existing employment sites Local Plan Delivery Policy EI2 (ER7), Industrial Heritage Conservation Area.There are existing businesses on the site. Site investigation required. Summary: The site is considered to be deliverable for a range of uses including housing within five years. The site is allocated in the Local Plan as suitable for mixed use redevelopment, including employment development, provided there are demonstrable environmental and/or conservation benefits. The site is available now and there is a reasonable prospect that development as envisaged will be delivered on the site.. This site could be partially redeveloped for medum to high density housing including apartments and the suggested yield on this part of the site is around 10 units.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
